title: Miracula SS. Cosmae et Damiani (Greek miracle collections) / «Чудеса святых Космы и Дамиана»
author: Anonymous (shrine of the Kosmidion, Constantinople)
edition: Deubner, Kosmas und Damian (Teubner 1907), public domain; Rupprecht (1935)
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Косма и Дамиан' cites no translation of the Greek miracles; not found on azbyka. Needs check in 19th-century church journals.
en_evidence: Open Library: only French (Festugière 1971). DOML 'Miracle Tales from Byzantium' (2012) covers Thecla and others, not Cosmas and Damian.
other_translations: French: Festugière, Collections grecques de miracles (1971)
value: Incubation at the Kosmidion: patients, doctors, diseases, Jews and pagans healed. A key source for Byzantine medicine and Constantinopolitan social history, directly comparable to the Asclepian iamata.
ai_feasibility: high: simple narrative koine; public-domain critical text.
